content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

PayPal and Stripe are popular choices for digital product sales, but they come with significant limitations. PayPal can freeze accounts for up to 180 days without an appeal, jeopardizing funds and access to revenue. Stripe, while reliable, is not accessible in many countries, creating a barrier for creators eager to monetize their work. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack enables you to build an online store without reliance on these platforms. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you gain full control over your sales, payment processing, and data ownership, ensuring that your business operates seamlessly regardless of location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy often exclude specific countries due to regulatory compliance and risk management, leaving creators stranded. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a structural alternative that embraces all creators, regardless of their geographical location. With our sovereign commerce stacks, you are not dependent on any single entity that can deny you access or impose significant restrictions. The infrastructure is designed to be universally accessible, empowering creators in Nigeria and beyond to sell digital products without the traditional barriers imposed by mainstream payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, conventional platforms often impose high fees and long processing times. PayPal may take days to release funds, while Stripe charges transaction fees that can accumulate quickly. In contrast, NOWPayments integrated into COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack charges only a 0.5% fee, with payments processed almost instantaneously on-chain. This means you keep more of your earnings and can reinvest them into your business without unnecessary delays. By choosing sovereign commerce infrastructure, you position yourself for greater financial efficiency and smoother cash flow.
Take control of your digital commerce with sovereign infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most critical aspects of online business is ownership. With platforms like Gumroad, you may face restrictions on your data and revenue streams. In contrast, COREMERCH ensures that after deployment, you own everything—your store, your customer data, and your revenue. Our systems automate payment verification and product delivery through a fully tested infrastructure, meaning you can focus on creating content rather than managing complex logistics. This ownership model creates a permanent, secure environment for your digital products and removes the vulnerabilities associated with relying on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Deciding between conventional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure depends on your specific needs. If you prioritize ownership, autonomy, and low fees, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is the superior choice. It provides a complete solution deployed in 48 hours with 30 days of support, ensuring that you can start selling your ebooks almost immediately. In contrast, continuing to rely on platforms like PayPal or Stripe comes with the risk of account freezes and limited access to funds. For creators in restricted countries, the infrastructure offered by COREMERCH is not just a workaround; it’s a foundational shift towards sovereignty in digital commerce.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
